game.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition
game.blurb: Open-world crime action-adventure, a remaster of the 2004 Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, from Grove Street Games and Rockstar Games, released 2021-11-11. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters follow the StrategyWiki walkthrough sections, with side activities drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Los Santos
chapters.summary: The opening stretch of the story in the home city, from the first mission to the end of the first city section.

chapters.title: The Countryside and San Fierro
chapters.summary: The second section of the story: the countryside towns, then the second city.

chapters.title: The Desert and Las Venturas
chapters.summary: The third section of the story: the desert airstrip and the casino city.

chapters.title: Back to Los Santos
chapters.summary: The final section of the story, back in the first city, up to the last mission.

chapters.title: Vehicle Jobs, Schools and Challenges
chapters.summary: Vigilante, Paramedic, Firefighter and Taxi jobs, vehicle schools, the BMX and NRG challenges, and the car export lists.

chapters.title: Minigames and Gambling
chapters.summary: Basketball, dancing, Inside Track betting, the Wheel of Fortune and roulette.

chapters.title: Stats, Turf and Lifestyle
chapters.summary: Food, weight, houses, Pay 'n' Spray, weapon skills, respect, sex appeal, dating, wanted levels and gang turf.

chapters.title: 100% Completion
chapters.summary: Reaching 100%, starting again afterwards and unlocking every achievement.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2021 remaster; it uses its own Steam app 1547000 (the schema names it "Trilogy - GTA:SA"). StrategyWiki has no page for the Definitive Edition ("Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition" and "Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition" are both missing). Its guide for the 2004 original, "Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas", is at completion stage 4 with 172 written subpages, including every mission page in the Walkthrough, so it was used (CC BY-SA 4.0): the four story chapters follow the Walkthrough's four sections (Los Santos, San Fierro, Las Venturas, Los Santos second time), reworded, with no text copied. The guide covers the original, so mission order for the remaster should be checked against it. The SW Walkthrough lists "Yay Ka-Boom-Boom" as the last San Fierro mission, so its achievement ("What happens in Las Venturas...") sits in the San Fierro chapter despite its name. StrategyWiki also has "Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy" (completion stage 3, categories include 2021 and Grove Street Games), but it is a compilation page showing achievement images, with no walkthrough, so it was not used. gta.fandom.com answers the API under "Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas" (the original game) with about 309 linked articles; it has no page under the Definitive Edition title; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 3 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden and have their own chapter. RAWG's playtime of 3 hours looks low for this game.
